ई: ई The fourth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to I long, having the sound of ee in feel, and distinguished by an accent from the former, as ī.
ई m. (ईः) A name of KANDARPA. 	 f. (ईः) A name of LAKSHMI. ind. An interjection of, 1. Pain. 	 2. Anger. 	 3. Consciousness or percep-tion. 	 4. Consideration. 	 5. Compassion.

ई r. 2nd cl. (एति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To pervade. 	 3. To conceive or become pregnant. 	 4. To desire. 	 5. To throw or direct. 	 6. To eat. This root is not generally admitted, though it occurs in composition, as with उत् (उदीते) To appear. r. 4th cl. (ङ) ईङ् (ईयते) To go.
ईक्ष: ईक्ष r. 1st cl. (ईक्षते) To see. It most usually occurs compounded with one or other of the prepositions, as with अप, to expect; with अभि, to gaze at; with अव, to inspect; with उत् or उप, to expect or await; with उप, to abandon; with निर्, to see; with परि, to try, to test, to assay; with प्र, to see, to resemble, or look like; with वि, to inspect; with प्रति, 1. to took for, to expect, 2. to venerate; with सम्, to compare, to contrast, to select; with प्रति and उत्, to look up at.
ईक्षण: ईक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Sight, seeing. 	 2. An eye.  E. ईक्ष् to see, ल्युट् aff.
ईक्षणिका: ईक्षणिका f. (-का) A female fortune-teller.  E. ईक्षण seeing, वुन् aff.
ईक्षमाण: ईक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Looking at, surveying.  E. ईक्ष् to see, शानच् aff.
ईक्षित: ईक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld.  E. ईक्ष् and क्त aff.
ईख: ईख r. 1st cl. (ङ) (ईखति) To go.; also (इ) ईखि (ईंखति.)
ईज: ईज r. 1st cl. (ङ) (ईजते) 1. To go. 	 2. To blame or censure; also (इञ्) ईजिञ् (ईंजति-ते.)
ईड: ईड r. 2nd cl. (ईट्टे) also 10th cl. (ईडयति) To praise.
ईडण: ईडण n. (-णं) Praising.  E. ईड and ल्युट् aff.
ईडा: ईडा f. (-डा) Praise.  E. ईड् to praise, क and टाप affs.
ईडित: ईडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended.  E. ईड् to praise, क्त aff.
ईड्य: ईड्य mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं) To be praised, to be glorified.  E. ईड् to praise, क्यप् aff.
ईत: ईत r. 1st cl. (इ) ईति (ईंतति) To bind.
ईत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone.  E. ई to go, क्त aff.
ईति: ईति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Calamity of season, as draught, excessive rain, rats, foreign invasion, &c. 	 2. Travelling in foreign countries, sojourning. 3. An affray.  E. ईङ् to go. affix क्तिन्.
ईदृक्ष: ईदृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Such.  E. ई for इदम् this, दृश् to see, क्विन् aff.
ईदृश्: ईदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such, so like.  E. ई for इदम् this, दृश् with क्विप् aff.
ईदृश: ईदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, so like. E. As the last, with कञ् aff.
ईप्सन: ईप्सन n. (-नं) Desiring, wishing to obtain.  E. आप् to obtain, desiderative form, ल्युट् aff.
ईप्सित: ईप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired.  E. आप् to obtain, desiderative form, क्त aff.
ईप्सु: ईप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous, wishing to get or obtain.  E. आप् to ob-tain, desiderative form, उस् aff.
ईर: ईर r. 2nd cl. (ईर्त्ते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To shake. r. 1st and 10th cls. (ईरति, ईरयति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To throw or direct, to drive or force on; with उत् prefixed, to say or speak; with प्र, to send, to make to go; with सम्, to go like the wind.
ईयिवस्: ईयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वस्) 	 1. Gone, having gone. 	 2. Having obtained. E. ईण् to go, क्वसु aff. form irr.
ईरिण: ईरिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Desert. 	 2. Saline and barren (soil.)  E. ऋ to go, and इरन् aff.
ईरित: ईरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sent, dispatched. 	 2. Said, uttered. 	 3. Gone. 4. Made.  E. ईर् to send, affix क्त.
ईरिताकूत: ईरिताकूत n. (-तं) Declared purpose or intention.  E. ईरित and आकूत purpose.
ईर्क्ष्य: ईर्क्ष्य r. 1st cl. (ईर्क्ष्यति) To envy, to feel impatient at another's prosperity.
ईर्म: ईर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) A sore or wound.  E. ईर् to send, and मक् aff.
ईर्म्म: ईर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) A sore or wound.  E. ईर् to send, and मक् aff.
ईर्या: ईर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Wandering about as a religious mendicant.  E. ईर् to go, affix क्यप्.
ईर्य्या: ईर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Wandering about as a religious mendicant.  E. ईर् to go, affix क्यप्.
ईर्वारु: ईर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus;) also ईर्व्वालु and ईर्व्वारु, &c.
ईर्व्वारु: ईर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus;) also ईर्व्वालु and ईर्व्वारु, &c.
ईर्षा: ईर्षा f. (-र्षा) Impatience, envy of another's success; more properly read ईर्ष्या.
ईर्षालु: ईर्षालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Impatient of another's success, envious.  E. ईर्षा and आलुच् affix: see ईर्ष्यालु.
ईर्षित: ईर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Envied. 	 n. (-तं) Envy.  E. ईर्षा and इतच् affix, or ईर्ष् with क्त aff.
ईर्ष्य: ईर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) Envious, envying. 	 f. (-र्ष्या) 	 1. Envy or impatience of another's success. 	 2. Spite, malice.  E. ईर्ष्य to envy, and अच् and टाप affixes; also, but according to the best writers, inaccurately written ईर्षा.
ईर्ष्यक: ईर्ष्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Envious, envying.  E. ईर्ष्य and वुन् aff.
ईर्ष्यमान: ईर्ष्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Envying, envious.  E. ईर्ष्य and शानच् aff.
ईर्ष्यालु: ईर्ष्यालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Envious.  E. ईर्ष्य and आलुच् affix; also written ईर्षालु.
ईर्ष्यावश: ईर्ष्यावश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Being overcome with envy.  E. ईर्ष्या and वश subjection.
ईर्ष्यिन्: ईर्ष्यिन् mfn. (-र्ष्यी-र्ष्यिणी-र्ष्यि) Envious, spiteful.  E. ईर्ष्या and इनि affix. So ईर्ष्यावत् (-वान्-वती-वत्) and ईर्ष्यामय (-यः-यी-यं.)
ईलित: ईलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised.  E. इड् to praise, affix क्त, and ड changed to ल.
ईली: ईली f. (-ली) A weapon, sometimes considered as a cudgel, and some-times as a short sword, or a stick shaped like a sword.  E. ईर् to go, &c. क and ङीप् affixes, and र changed to ल; see इली; also ईलि, &c.
ईश: ईश r. 2nd cl. (ङ) ईशङ् (ईष्टे) To possess power, property, or authority.
ईश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Also of the same deity as regent of the north-east quarter. 	 3. A ruler, a master. 	 f. (-शा) The shaft of a plough.  E. ईश् to rule, क aff.
ईशसखि: ईशसखि m. (-खा) A name of KUVERA.  E. ईश SIVA, and सखि a friend.
ईशादन्त: ईशादन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. An elephant with large tusks. 	 2. The tusk of an elephant.  E. ईशा and दन्त a tooth; whose tooth is of the size of a plough-shaft, or the tooth which is so.
ईशान: ईशान m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Also of the same deity as regent of the north-east quarter. 	 3. One of the Rudras. 	 4. The sun as a form of SIVA. 	 mf. (-नः-नी) The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 	 n. (-नं) Light, splendor. 	 f. (-नी) A name of DURGA.  E. ईश a master, &c. and आनच् affix, and fem. ङीष्.
ईशिता: ईशिता f. (-ता) Superiority, supremacy, one of the eight attributes of divinity.  E. ईश a master, and तल् abstract affix; also ईशित्वं.
ईशितृ: ईशितृ m. (-ता) 	 1. A master, an owner or proprietor. 	 2. A king.  E. ईश् to rule, and तृच् aff.
ईश्वर: ईश्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. The supreme ruler of the universe, GOD; it is therefore applied to all the different divinities, but mostly designates SIVA, in mythological and popular acceptation. According to the Sank-hyas, Iswara is the liberated spirit; finite, according to KAPILA; infinite, according to PATANJALI. In the Nyaya system, Iswara is also a finite spirit endowed with attributes. In the Vedanta, Iswara is infinite and universal spirit, the cause and substance of creation. 2. A name of SIVA, especially in a compound, when the form of the deity implied is a Linga, as Visweswara, Someswara, Rameswara, &c. 	 3. KAMADEVA. 	 mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. An owner, a proprietor, a chief or head. 	 2. Able, competent. 	 f. (-रा or -री) 1. A name of DURGA. 	 2. Of LAKSHMI, or of any other of the Raktis or female energies of the deities.  E. ईश् to rule, and वरट् or वरच् affix, consequently ङीप् or टाप् for the feminine.
ईश्वरभाव: ईश्वरभाव m. (-वः) Royal or imperial nature.  E. ईश्वर a sovereign, and भाव disposition.
ईश्वरसभा: ईश्वरसभा f. (-भा) Royal court or assembly.  E. ईश्वर and सभा an assembly.
ईश्वराधीन: ईश्वराधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to a king, dependent on a master or on GOD, &c.  E. ईश्वर, अधि over, ख aff.
ईश्वराधीनता: ईश्वराधीनता f. (-ता) Dependance upon GOD, subjection to a ruler. E. ईश्वराधीन and तल् added; also with त्व, ईश्वराधीनत्वं.
ईष: ईष r. 1st cl. (ङ) ईषङ् (ईषते) 1. To go or move. 	 2. To kill or hurt. 	 3. To see. 	 4. To give. (उ) ईषु (ईषति) To glean.
ईष m. (-षः) The month Aswin: see इष.
ईषज्जल: ईषज्जल n. (-लं) Shallow water, a little water.  E. ईषत् and जल water.
ईषत्: ईषत् ind. A little.  E. ईष् to go, अत् aff.
ईषत्कर: ईषत्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Diminutive, delicate. 	 2. Doing little. 	 3. What little is done to or made of.  E. ईषत् a little, and कर what makes.
ईषत्पान: ईषत्पान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What is little drank or drank little of.  E. ईषत् and पान drink.
ईषत्प्रलम्भ: ईषत्प्रलम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) What is little gained of.  E. ईषत् and प्रलम्भ profit.
ईषदुष्ण: ईषदुष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Tepid, slightly warm.  E. ईषत् and उष्ण warm.
ईषद्गुण: ईषद्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Of little merit.  E. ईषत् and गुण quality.
ईषत्पाण्डु: ईषत्पाण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A pale or light brown colour.  E. ईषत् a little, and पाण्डु pale.
ईषत्पुरुष: ईषत्पुरुष m. (-षः) A mean man.  E. ईषत् and पुरुष a man.
ईषदून: ईषदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not quite complete or entire.  E. ईषत् and ऊन less.
ईषद्दर्शन: ईषद्दर्शन n. (-नं) A glance at, a slight inspection.  E. ईषत् and दर्शन seeing.
ईषद्धास: ईषद्धास m. (-सः) A smile.  E. ईषत् a little, and हास laughter.
ईषद्रक्त: ईषद्रक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Of a pale red (colour.)  E. ईषत् and रक्त red.
ईषन्निमय: ईषन्निमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Exchanged for a little.  E. ईषत् and नियम barter.
ईषल्लभ: ईषल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) What little is or can be gained of.  E. ईषत and लभ what gets.
ईषा: ईषा f. (-षा) The pole or shaft of a plough.  E. ईष् to go, affixes क and टाप्; also ईशा.
ईषादण्ड: ईषादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The handle of a plough.  E. ईषा the staff, and दण्ड a stick.
ईषादन्त: ईषादन्त m. (-न्तः) An elephant with a large tusk or tooth.  E. ईषा and दन्त a tooth: see ईशादन्त.
ईषिका: ईषिका f. (-का) 	 1. An elephant's eye-ball: see ईषीका. 	 2. A painter's brush, &c. see ईषीका. 	 3. A weapon, a dart or arrow.  E. ईष् to hurt, किकन् affix.
ईषिर: ईषिर m. (-रः) Fire.  E. ईष् to injure, and किरच् aff.
ईषीका: ईषीका f. (-का) 	 1. A painter's brush, a fibrous stick used as one. 	 2. An ingot mould. 	 3. A dipping-rod, or something cast into a crucible to examine if the metal it contains is in fusion: see ईषिका.  E. ईष् to go, ईकन् Unādi aff.
ईष्म: ईष्म m. (-ष्मः) 	 1. KAMADEVA. 	 2. Spring: see इष्म.
ईह: ईह r. 1st cl. (ङ) ईहङ् (ईहते) To endeavour, to aim or attempt. With सम् prefixed, to wish, to desire.
ईहमान: ईहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Performing, undertaking.  E. ईह् to make effort, शानच् aff.
ईहा: ईहा f. (-हा) 	 1. Wish, desire. 	 2. Effort, exertion.  E. ईह् to desire, अङ् and टाप् affs.
ईहातस्: ईहातस् ind. Diligently, by energetically, or with labour or exertion. E. तसि substituted for the regular case.
ईहामृग: ईहामृग m. (-गः) 	 1. A wolf. 	 2. A division of the drama.  E. ईहा wish, and मृग a deer.
ईहार्थिन्: ईहार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 	 1. Aiming at any object. 	 2. Seeking wealth. E. इह् to seek, अर्थ wealth, इनि aff.
ईहावृक: ईहावृक m. (-कः) A wolf.  E. ईहा and वृक a wolf.
ईहित: ईहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sought, attempted, made effort for. 	 2. Wished, desired.  E. ईह् to wish, क्त aff.
